hypothesis: The fitted prompt-length slope is small. Replacing it with scheduler request cardinality may explain batch-position variation that length-only models leave unresolved, while retaining the observed startup and medium-prompt regimes.

pcvs.name: resident_requests
pcvs.rationale: Exposes request population at entry, distinguishing positions within each submitted batch and possible batch-start effects.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 9)
pcvs.name: nine_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Retains the indicator for the elevated nine-token state.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 10)
pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Retains the indicator for the highest-cost observed state.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 12 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) < 23)
pcvs.name: medium_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Retains the medium-prompt regime from the best-performing candidate.
